purpose: Teach: 読み書き/本誌/常務/出回っ/既婚/上述/免責/全長

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新人の読み書きスキルを評価しましょう
lines.en: Let's start by evaluating the new hire's reading and writing skills.
lines.style: Crisp, professional opening. Clean attack on the first syllable. Steady pace, no hesitation. Speaking from a checklist—organized, task-focused.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。本誌記事を社内報にも転載します
lines.en: Understood. I'll also make sure the article gets reprinted in the company newsletter.
lines.style: Calm affirmation. Light nod in the voice. Acknowledging while already moving to the next step. Reliable, no flourish.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 常務会議で新方針を承認してもらいましょう
lines.en: We should get the new policy approved at the executive meeting.
lines.style: Slightly forward-leaning. Purposeful tone. Small emphasis on 'approved'—this matters. Speaking with quiet confidence, not requesting.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。市場に出回っている類似品を調査中です
lines.en: Understood. We're currently looking into similar products already on the market.
lines.style: Steady update voice. Factual, no drama. A slight pause before the detail, like checking off a point. Professional but present.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 既婚者向けの社宅制度を案内しましょう
lines.en: Let's put together an announcement about the new housing program for married employees.
lines.style: Clear instruction, slightly warmer than the first. Not commanding—collaborative. Even pace. The kind of direction that expects competent execution.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。上述の通り、改善計画を出します
lines.en: Understood. As I mentioned, I'll submit the improvement plan.
lines.style: Confirming tone. Light reference back to what was said before—a little nod of continuity. Steady, factual. Ready to move on.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 保険の免責範囲を社員に説明しましょう
lines.en: We need to explain the insurance deductible limits to the staff.
lines.style: Instructional but not stern. Methodical. Speaking as someone moving through necessary items. Clear and direct without urgency.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。商品の全長表記を統一しました
lines.en: Understood. I've already standardized the product length labeling.
lines.style: Finishing affirmation. Light satisfaction—a task complete. Slight slowdown at the end, like setting something down. Closed loop, ready for the next one.
